# cortexcloud_indicator (Data Source)

Looks up a single Indicator of Compromise (IOC) by either its `indicator` value or its server-assigned `rule_id`. Exactly one of the two must be set.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `indicator` (String) The IOC value to look up. Mutually exclusive with `rule_id`.
- `rule_id` (Number) The server-assigned numeric ID to look up. Mutually exclusive with `indicator`.

### Read-Only

- `comment` (String)
- `creation_time` (Number)
- `default_expiration_enabled` (Boolean)
- `expiration_date` (Number)
- `id` (String) Mirror of the resolved `indicator` value.
- `modification_time` (Number)
- `number_of_issues` (Number)
- `reliability` (String)
- `reputation` (String)
- `severity` (String)
- `source` (String)
- `status` (String)
- `type` (String)
